name: android-analysis-triage-workflow
description: Evidence-led static and isolated dynamic triage of Android APKs and split APK sets for a user-supplied package name, with an analyst handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Static and isolated dynamic APK triage
interface.longDescription: Provide the Android package name to start APK or split-set analysis. A full triage checks the manifest, inspects code, permissions, libraries, and URLs, then runs the app for five minutes in an Android emulator inside a disposable VM with a verified Tor/Privoxy gateway. The handoff includes image hashes and runtime logs. No external account or MCP server is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this APK for package PACKAGE_NAME using $android-analysis-triage-workflow.
